# google_design_center_connection

A connection between two components in an Application Design Center Application Template.


To get more information about Connection, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/application-design-center/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.spaces.applicationTemplates.components.connections)
* How-to Guides
    * [Application Design Center Overview](https://cloud.google.com/application-design-center/docs/overview)
    * [Design an application template](https://cloud.google.com/application-design-center/docs/design-application-templates)

## Example Usage - Designcenter Connection Basic


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_connection" "example" {
  project                   = "my-project-name"
  location                  = "us-central1"
  space                     = "my-space"
  application_template      = "my-application-template"
  component                 = "my-source-component"
  connection_id             = "example-connection"
  destination_component_uri = "projects/my-project-name/locations/us-central1/spaces/my-space/applicationTemplates/my-application-template/components/my-dest-component"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `destination_component_uri` -
  (Required)
  The component URI that the connection points to.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/spaces/{space}/applicationTemplates/{application_template}/components/{component}`

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the space.

* `space` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the space.

* `application_template` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the application template.

* `component` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the component.

* `connection_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the connection.


* `source_component_parameters` -
  (Optional)
  Parameters associated with the source component. When both parameter lists
  are unset on creation, the API fills these in from the connected
  components.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_source_component_parameters).

* `destination_component_parameters` -
  (Optional)
  Parameters associated with the destination component. When both parameter
  lists are unset on creation, the API fills these in from the connected
  components.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_destination_component_parameters).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_source_component_parameters"></a>The `source_component_parameters` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key of the parameter.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  The value of the parameter, as a JSON-encoded string. Use
  `jsonencode()` to set it.

<a name="nested_destination_component_parameters"></a>The `destination_component_parameters` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key of the parameter.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  The value of the parameter, as a JSON-encoded string. Use
  `jsonencode()` to set it.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component}}/connections/{{connection_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the connection.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/spaces/{space}/applicationTemplates/{application_template}/components/{component}/connections/{connection_id}`

* `create_time` -
  Connection creation timestamp.

* `update_time` -
  Connection update timestamp.

* `dependency_type` -
  The dependency type of the connection. Possible values include
  `CONNECTION_DEPENDENCY_TYPE_DATA` and
  `CONNECTION_DEPENDENCY_TYPE_LOGICAL`.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Connection can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component}}/connections/{{connection_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component}}/{{connection_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component}}/{{connection_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Connection using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    space = "<-required value->"
    application_template = "<-required value->"
    component = "<-required value->"
    connection_id = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_design_center_connection.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Connection using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component}}/connections/{{connection_id}}"
  to = google_design_center_connection.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Connection can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_design_center_connection.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template}}/components/{{component}}/connections/{{connection_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_connection.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component}}/{{connection_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_connection.default {{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template}}/{{component}}/{{connection_id}}
```
